aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: A plain-language guide to switching health insurance so you know what to expect before you commit.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Switching health insurance is simpler than most people think. This guide covers portability rules, waiting periods, and the top things to check before you change.
faqFragments: Q: Do I lose my waiting periods if I switch? A: No. Served waiting periods are portable between registered health insurers.
Q: How long does switching take? A: Most switches complete within a few days and your new cover starts the day your old policy ends.

aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: Everything families should know before choosing health insurance, from hospital tiers to extras benefits.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Choosing health insurance for a family involves balancing premium cost, hospital cover level, and which extras matter most for your family.
faqFragments: Q: Should I get hospital and extras? A: Most families benefit from having both, but the right combination depends on your family's health needs.
Q: What extras matter most for families? A: Dental, optical, and physiotherapy tend to be the most used extras for families with children.
